sloka: न सीतायाः परां भार्यां वव्रे स रघुनन्दनः ।यज्ञे यज्ञे च पत्न्यर्थं जानकी काञ्चनी भवत् ।। ७.९९.८ ॥
transliteration: na sītāyāḥ parāṁ bhāryāṁ vavre sa raghunandanaḥ ।yajñe yajñe ca patnyarthaṁ jānakī kāñcanī bhavat ।। 7.99.8 ॥

translations.english: That Rama, the delight of Raghu, did not choose another wife besides Sita, and in every sacrifice, a golden image of Janaki served as his wife.
